propositions: _pai_check_config raises loudly on any base_url/api_key despite documentation claiming support and config.py already parsing them

OpenAI-compatible local servers (Ollama, LMStudio, vLLM) cannot reliably implement strict json_schema output, requiring the profile's supports_json_schema_output flag to be withdrawn for custom endpoints while preserving other capabilities

base_url is provider configuration (not selection) and should only trigger eager builder registration when explicitly set; a bare openai:gpt-4o with no base_url must remain a lazy model string to keep the openai SDK optional

the profile override must ride the Provider class (via a rebar OpenAIProvider subclass overriding model_profile staticmethod), not OpenAIChatModel constructor args, because pydantic-ai's infer_model builds the model after the seam returns a Provider
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL already routes through non-loopback gateways by accident via SDK env-var reading and must be tested explicitly so the behavior cannot regress
